title: Very Good
body: Had it for a couple weeks now and it has been working very well. When you complete the task it makes a little sound that I find nice and makes you happy, I still haven’t found how you can skip the task for the day Bec I fell asleep early one day and didn’t do my morning routine and my whole streak was gone which made me a tad upset but it’s ok.
author: BriMBry
